instruction.name: ldx.hu
instruction.description: ldx.hu indexed load from rj + rk.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.init: addi.d $r20, $sp, -1024; addi.d $r4, $r0, 0; addi.d $r5, $r0, 8; addi.d $r6, $r0, 16; addi.d $r7, $r0, 24; addi.d $r8, $r0, 32; addi.d $r9, $r0, 40; addi.d $r10, $r0, 48; addi.d $r11, $r0, 56
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --init 'addi.d $r20, $sp, -1024; addi.d $r4, $r0, 0; addi.d $r5, $r0, 8; addi.d $r6, $r0, 16; addi.d $r7, $r0, 24; addi.d $r8, $r0, 32; addi.d $r9, $r0, 40; addi.d $r10, $r0, 48; addi.d $r11, $r0, 56' --asm 'ldx.hu $r12, $r20, $r4; ldx.hu $r13, $r20, $r5; ldx.hu $r14, $r20, $r6; ldx.hu $r15, $r20, $r7; ldx.hu $r16, $r20, $r8; ldx.hu $r17, $r20, $r9; ldx.hu $r18, $r20, $r10; ldx.hu $r19, $r20, $r11'
throughput.notes: 8 independent memory operations take 4.00 cycles. Buffer is at $sp-1024.

notes: Throughput measured with a 1KB stack buffer. Latency not measured; memory latency depends on cache state.
